summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER AND SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES, THE FUEL FILLER HOSE MAY CRACK AND RESULT IN FUEL LEAKAGE FROM THE HOSE WHILE REFUELING.

title: QUALITY COACHES INC.: CENTER HIGH MOUNTED STOP LAMP/FMVSS 108 (2 affected)
summary: CERTAIN CONVERSION VANS BUILT ON GMC/CHEVROLET CHASSIS FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."  THE HOUSING LENS OF THE CENTER HIGH MOUNTED STOP LAMP DOES NOT ALLOW ENOUGH LIGHT TO EMIT FROM THE LAMP.

title: Wabash National Corporation: WEBB WHEEL/BRAKE DRUMS (6 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN  TRAILERS EQUIPPED WITH WEBB WHEEL PLATINUM SERIES BRAKE DRUMS, THE BRAKE DRUMS COULD CRACK ON THE BRAKING SURFACE.

title: Jayco, Inc.: HITCH RECEIVER MISSING REINFORCEMENT PLATE (1,878 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES, THE HITCH RECEIVER MAY HAVE MISSING REINFORCING PLATES.   WHEN A LOAD IS APPLIED TO THE HITCH, IT MAY BECOME PARTIALLY DETACHED FROM THE FRAME IF THESE PLATES ARE MISSING.

title: Thermo King Corp.: AUXILIARY POWER UNITS/POSSIBLE FIRE (8,000 affected)
summary: ALL TRIPAC AUXILIARY POWER UNITS (TRIPAC APU) TRIPAC TIER 1 (SERIAL NUMBER RANGE 023D00A001 TO 065D02A022) AND TRIPAC TIER 2 (SERIAL NUMBER RANGE 0453TC0001 TO 1153TC5116) INSTALLED AS AFTERMARKET EQUIPMENT FOR USE ON HEAVY TRUCKS TO REDUCE UNNECESSARY TRUCK IDLE AND CONSERVE DIESEL FUEL.  THE APU'S CIRCUIT PROTECTION IS NOT ADEQUATE TO PROTECT AGAINST ELECTRICAL FAULTS IN THE APU.

title: General Motors, LLC: SEAT BELT BUCKLES (425,593 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN FULL-SIZE PASSENGER, CARGO, OR CUTAWAY VANS, THE FRONT AND REAR SEAT BELT BUCKLES WILL NOT LATCH OR WILL NOT UNLATCH.

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: ACCELERATOR PEDAL (3,567 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES, THERE IS A POSSIBILITY THAT THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL MAY TEMPORARILY BECOME STUCK IN THE PARTIALLY DEPRESSED POSITION DUE TO INADEQUATE CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL LINKAGE AND A PLASTIC PAD EMBEDDED INTO THE VEHICLE'S CARPET.

title: MONACO COACH CORPORATION: DRIVELINE STRAPS (30 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN CLASS A MOTOR HOMES BUILT WITH CUMMINS ISX 600 HP ENGINES, THE STRAPS THAT HOLD THE U-JOINTS ONTO THE REAR END AND THE TRANSMISSION CAN LOOSEN.  THE LOCK WASHER ON THE STRAPS CAN SPREAD OUT AND ALLOW THE MOUNTING BOLTS TO WORK LOOSE.  THIS CAN ALLOW THE DRIVELINE TO SEPARATE FROM THE TRANSMISSION AND FALL OFF THE MOTOR HOME.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: AIR BAG MODULE/FMVSS 208 (61,000 affected)
summary: CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH SPORT MODEL STEERING WHEELS FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 208, "OCCUPANT CRASH PROTECTION."  IN CERTAIN LOW RISK AIR BAG DEPLOYMENT TESTS CONDUCTED BY NHTSA, USING AN OUT-OF-POSITION UNBELTED 5TH PERCENTILE FEMALE CRASH TEST DUMMY, IRREGULARITIES WERE DEMONSTRATED INDICATING THAT OCCUPANTS MAY NOT BE PROPERLY PROTECTED IN A CRASH.

title: IC CORPORATION: HANDRAIL DESIGN/DOOR CONTROL BRACKET (1,918 affected)
summary: CERTAIN 2005-2007 CE AND MY 2007 BE SCHOOL AND TRANSIT BUSES MANUFACTURED BETWEEN FEBRUARY 10, 2004, AND DECEMBER 15, 2005.    PASSENGER COAT STRINGS OR CARRY ON ITEMS CAN GET CAUGHT BETWEEN THE DOOR CONTROL BRACKET AND THE DOOR CONTROL ARM AS THE PASSENGER EXITS THE BUS.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): HEADLIGHT SWITCH (6,786 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTORCYCLES, A DAMAGED CONNECTOR IN THE HANDLEBAR MOUNTED HEADLIGHT SWITCH MAY CAUSE THE HEADLIGHT TO FLICKER AND EVENTUALLY FAIL.

title: SABRY LEE, INC.: FMVSS 108/LED TAIL LIGHT/POSSIBLE ELECTRICAL FIRE (10 affected)
summary: CERTAIN EAGLE EYES TAIL LIGHTS SOLD AS AFTERMARKET FOR USE ON 1998-2004 BMW E46 MODEL VEHICLES.  THE SUBJECT LIGHTS WERE NOT MANUFACTURED TO A PROPER TOLERANCE TO FIT AN AUTOMATIC SYSTEM WHICH FAILS TO COMPLY WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."

title: Triple E Recreational Vehicles: MISSING SEATING LABELS/FMVSS 207 (14 affected)
summary: CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 207, "SEATING SYSTEMS."   VEHICLE SEATS THAT DO NOT HAVE A SEAT BELT MUST HAVE A DECAL ON THE SEATING LOCATION THAT STATES:  "THIS SEAT NOT FOR OCCUPANCY WHILE VEHICLE IS IN MOTION." THESE LABELS ARE MISSING.

title: Suzuki Motor USA, LLC: IGNITION SWITCH INSPECTION/REPLACEMENT (23,839 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTORCYCLES, THE IGNITION SWITCH WIRING HARNESS MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY ROUTED AT THE TIME OF PRODUCTION.  IF THE WIRING HARNESS IS NOT ROUTED PROPERLY, IT CAN RUB AGAINST THE CLUTCH CABLE/THROTTLE CABLE.

title: International Motors, LLC: ENGINE ELECTRICAL GROUND CABLE/CATERPILLAR (6,848 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH CATERPILLAR DIESEL ENGINES, THE ENGINE ELECTRICAL GROUND CABLE THAT CONNECTS THE ENGINE BLOCK WITH THE STARTER MAY BE ROUTED IN A WAY THAT COULD CAUSE CHAFING AGAINST THE STARTER'S POSITIVE BATTERY CABLES.

title: International Motors, LLC: AIR BRAKE SIZE AND CONFIGURATION/FMVSS 121 (2 affected)
summary: CERTAIN TRUCKS BUILT WITH A 8X6 WHEEL CONFIGURATION (TRIDEMS) FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 121, 'AIR BRAKE SYSTEMS.'  THE AS-BUILT AIR BRAKE COMPONENT SIZE AND CONFIGURATION ARE INADEQUATE FOR THE EXTENDED WHEELBASES CAUSING THE MID-REAR AND REAR-REAR AXLE BRAKE APPLY TIMING TO BE NONCOMPLIANT WITH THE STANDARD.

title: Big Dog Motorcycles, LLC: AFTERMARKET PILLION PADS (SEATS) (84 affected)
summary: CERTAIN AFTERMARKET PILLION PADS, BIG DOG MOTORCYCLES P/N BDM230-00195, BDM230-00194, AND BDM230-00081, WHEN USED ON ANY PRIMER-FINISHED BIG DOG MOTORCYCLES.  THE SUBJECT PILLION PAD MAY BE INCOMPATIBLE WITH THE PRIMER PAINT FINISH.  THE SUCTION MOUNTS OF THESE PILLION PADS MAY NOT ADEQUATELY ADHERE TO THIS PAINT FINISH.

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: 20" AFTERMARKET ALLOY WHEELS (22 affected)
summary: CERTAIN TOYOTA TUNDRA AND SEQUOIA TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH TOYOTA RACING DEVELOPMENT (TRD) 20" ALLOY WHEELS SOLD AND INSTALLED BY TOYOTA DEALERS AS AN AFTERMARKET ACCESSORY WHEEL.  DUE TO A MANUFACTURING ERROR, THE LUG-NUT HOLES WERE NOT MACHINED TO THE APPROPRIATE SPECIFICATION WHICH WILL REDUCE THREAD ENGAGEMENT.  THESE WHEELS MAY NOT MAINTAIN THE APPROPRIATE TORQUE SPECIFICATION REQUIRED SECURING THE WHEEL TO THE VEHICLE.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: VARIABLE VALVE ACTUATION OIL LINE/OIL LEAK (30,995 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRACTORS EQUIPPED WITH CATERPILLAR DIESEL ENGINES, THE VARIABLE VALVE ACTUATION OIL LINE MAY WEAR AGAINST THE SHARP EDGE OF THE CYLINDER HEAD IF NOT POSITIONED CORRECTLY.

title: Michelin North America, Inc.: RAPID AIR LOSS (4,600 affected)
summary: CERTAIN MICHELIN PILOT SPORT TIRES, SIZE 255/35ZR20 97Y EXTRA LOAD, SOLD FOR USE AS REPLACEMENT TIRES AND ALSO IMPORTED ON SOME JAGAUR XJ8 VEHICLES.  ALL OF THE AFFECTED TIRES HAVE DOT TIRE IDENTIFICATION NUMBERS THAT BEGIN WITH DOT FHPNEFMX AND END WITH THE LAST TWO DIGITS OF 00, 01, 02, 03 OR 05.  THE SUBJECT TIRES MAY DEVELOP A BLISTER IN THE SIDEWALL.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): OCCUPANT CLASSIFICATION SYSTEM (12,756 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN 2-DOOR PASSENGER VEHICLES, THE FRONT PASSENGER OCCUPANT DETECTION SYSTEM (ODS) CONTAINS A FAULTY ELECTRONIC COMPONENT.  AS A RESULT, THE ODS WILL NOT FUNCTION PROPERLY AND WILL NOT SUPPRESS FRONT PASSENGER AIR BAG DEPLOYMENT WHEN THE WEIGHT OF AN INFANT OR SMALL CHILD IS DETECTED IN THE FRONT PASSENGER SEAT.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: ENTRANCE STEPS/KWIKEE (193 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES EQUIPPED WITH KWIKEE BRAND ELECTRIC STEPS, THE STEPS MAY HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED WITH DEFECTIVE STEP CONTROL UNITS.

title: Lotus Cars Limited: GEAR LEVER (1,740 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH 6-SPEED MANUAL TRANSMISSIONS, THE GEAR LEVER MAY BREAK.

title: Maserati North America, Inc.: STEERING RACK (169 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES, THE POWER ASSIST DELIVERED BY THE STEERING RACK MAY NOT BE FULLY AVAILABLE WHILE MAKING EXTREME LEFT HAND TURNS FOR A PROLONGED PERIOD OF TIME.  AN INTERNAL O-RING OF THE STEERING RACK CAN BECOME DISLODGED OR DISLOCATED CAUSING A LOSS OF POWER ASSIST TO THE DRIVER.

title: CPSC, Chuck E. Cheese's Announce Recall of Plastic Siren Whistles
summary: The recalled plastic siren whistle's internal pieces can detach from the toy, posing a choking hazard to children. Units: About 144,000.

title: CPSC, J & F Design Inc. Announce Recall of Girl's Sleepwear Sold at J.C. Penney Stores
summary: These pajamas sets fail to meet the federal mandatory standard for flammability of children's sleepwear under the Flammable Fabrics Act. This poses a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 18,800 sets.

title: CPSC, Kawasaki Motors Corp. U.S.A. Announce Recall of All-Terrain Vehicles
summary: Tie rod separation caused by either wear or severe impact can occur during operation, causing the front wheel to separate from the steering control. Separation of the tie rod can cause the rider to lose control of the ATV, resulting in a serious injury or death to the rider. Units: About 21,900.

title: CPSC, Toshiba America Consumer Products LLC Announce Recall of DVD Home Theater Systems
summary: A problem in the system's circuit board could pose a fire hazard. Units: About 4,100.

title: CPSC, Ideal Distributors Inc. Announce Recall of Pacifiers
summary: The nipples can detach from the base, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,000.

title: CPSC, King of Fans Inc. Announce Recall of Oil-Filled Radiator Heaters
summary: Welds in the heating fins can break, allowing oil to leak. This poses a burn and fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 202,000.

title: CPSC, Petters Consumer Brands LLC Announce Recall of Batteries Found In Polaroid Portable DVD Players
summary: The battery can overheat and melt the plastic case while recharging, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 165,000.

title: CPSC, Recreational Equipment Inc. Announce Recall of Children's Bicycles
summary: The alloy frame used for these bicycles can be prone to fatigue failure. Frame failure results in the separation of the fork, head tube, and handlebar away from the rest of the bike, causing a loss of control and crash, and posing a risk of serious injury to the rider. Units: About 2,800.

title: CPSC, Simplicity Inc. Announce Recall of Graco Branded Aspen Cribs for Suffocation Risk
summary: The screws on the wooden mattress support can come loose, allowing a portion of the mattress to fall, posing a suffocation hazard to young children. Units: About 104,000.

title: CPSC, CFM Corporation Announce Recall of Legacy Propane Infrared Plaque Heaters
summary: Carbon monoxide hazard. A non-specification gasket around the heating plaques could allow heater carbon monoxide emissions to leak into the area in which the heater is being used. Units: About 10,200. All recalled heaters have been returned to CFM..

title: CPSC, Family Dollar Stores Announce Recall of Spinning Star Christmas Tree Topper
summary: The tree topper can melt or smoke near the on/off switch, which could pose a fire hazard. Units: About 13,000.

title: CPSC, Meco Corp. Announce Recall to Repair Gas Grills
summary: The regulators on these gas grills, the component that controls the amount of gas released to the burner, can leak propane when the propane cylinder is connected and open, and the grill is not in use. Units: About 98,000.

title: CPSC, Black Diamond Equipment Announce Recall of Scarpa T2X Telemark Ski Boots
summary: The plastic boot cuff can crack when flexed open in an unbuckled non-skiing position, causing discomfort on the ankle or shin, making the problem evident prior to skiing and thus unsuitable for use. Units: About 2,300 pairs.

title: CPSC, Dell Announce Recall of Notebook Computer Batteries
summary: These batteries can overheat, which could pose a fire risk. Units: About 22,000 in the U.S..

title: CPSC, Advantage Publishers Group Announce Recall of Children's Books
summary: If the clear plastic container is removed from the book's back cover or breaks, young children can access the beads in it. This poses a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 41,000.

title: CPSC, General Electric Announce Recall of Gas Ranges Posing Fire Hazard
summary: These ranges were manufactured with a design flaw that can cause an electrical arc between the wiring and adjacent gas supply tubes at two locations in the control housing of the range, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 6,600.

title: CPSC, American Honda Motor Corp. Announce Recall of All-Terrain Vehicles
summary: A safety defect could exist in the transmission, that could allow the rider to downshift from 1st gear into reverse, without operating the reverse assist (lockout) lever. The reverse lockout spring may not have been properly installed. Unintended engagement of reverse gear while moving forward could

title: CPSC, Celebrate Express Inc. Announce Recall of Magic Party Favors and Costume Shield
summary: The magic party favors and the dragon ornament on the shield could break or crack, exposing sharp points that present a possible laceration hazard to children. Units: About 21,100 magic party favors and 25,500 costume shields.

title: CPSC, Maxim Enterprise Inc. Announce Recall of Mini Learning Cube Toy Sold at Target
summary: Small wooden pegs in the top corners of the toy can come loose, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 12,000.

title: CPSC, Kids II Inc. Announce Recall of Doorway Baby Jumpers
summary: The plastic clamp that attaches the jumper seat to a door frame can break, which can cause the unit and child to fall to the floor. This poses an injury hazard to young children. Units: About 14,000.
